prompt: Type continuously in the MLAIX input field for 30 seconds; no dropped characters or stale value reversion.
expected_outcome: All typed characters appear in order; no binding reversion overwrites user input.

prompt: Move cursor repeatedly while typing; insertion point must track user selection without jumps.
expected_outcome: Insertion point binding matches NSTextView.selectedRange at all times.

prompt: Toggle Search and Functions while typing; input text must remain unchanged and editable.
expected_outcome: Text binding value is identical before and after toggling UI controls.

prompt: Insert a quick prompt chip; editor should update exactly once with the selected prompt text.
expected_outcome: Binding receives one update with the chip text; no duplicate or empty intermediate values.

prompt: Switch conversation and return; focused editor should preserve fresh typing behavior.
expected_outcome: Editor text resets on conversation switch; new keystrokes are not lost.

prompt: IME composition (marked text) must not propagate intermediate values to the binding.
expected_outcome: textDidChange is suppressed while hasMarkedText() returns true.

prompt: Trigger speech permission callback path; no actor-isolation crash or dispatch assert.
expected_outcome: SpeechService callback executes on MainActor without runtime assertion failures.

prompt: Run strict-concurrency complete build for MLAIX; no new errors in touched files.
expected_outcome: swift build completes with zero concurrency errors in files changed since last passing run.

prompt: Build both SwiftPM executables (MLAIX and llama-server-watchdog) and run full test suite.
expected_outcome: swift build -c release, swift build --product llama-server-watchdog, and swift test all exit 0.
command: swift build -c release --product MLAIX && swift build --product llama-server-watchdog && swift test

prompt: Apply each ThemePreset and verify accent color updates; reset to default restores nil accent.
expected_outcome: ThemePreset.accentHex is applied to AppStorage; default preset clears custom accent.

prompt: Set accent color via hex string, persist to UserDefaults, read back; round-trip must match.
expected_outcome: Color(hex:).toHex produces the original 6-char hex (ignoring alpha).

prompt: Set font scale to values outside 0.8-1.3 range; UI must clamp to 1.0 fallback.
expected_outcome: FontScaleModifier applies scaleEffect(1.0) for out-of-range values.
